briefs.name: Desk Terminal, Wired
briefs.hypothesis: Patched already ties for the lead on soul, style, system and interaction. It lost points on a short list of concrete faults the judges named: the ring tick, the lower-left hole, the colourless unlit lower half, the cold steel slab, Tab order and the colliding map labels. A fix for each of those keeps every praised device. Two grafts then answer the lessons' two open complaints. Waypoint's day numeral gives one mark to row, dial and month, which judges called the field's best comprehension and type device. Grounded kind rings with one lit newest lamp give the desk colour and give each section exactly one light. Together they turn Patched from one lit cable into a wired system on every page. The original's tube light comes back at full strength on the glass, the dial, the lead and the lamps, while the desk stays calm and coloured. That should lift usability (7.3) and type (7.8) to the level of its soul, style and system scores, without the convergence that flattened the field.
briefs.brief:
Start from x14a-desk-cross: copy cross/x14b-a/palettes/x14a-desk-cross.json and cross/x14b-a/variants/x14a-desk-cross/ (sheet.css is 179.6k of the 200k budget; cut dead rules to make room). Keep at a glance: the cased terminal at the left of every page (.bench > .terminal, sticky, --term-w 27rem), the thin 6px case and 2px bezel, the title on Home's glass with the one white-hot word and the single block cursor, the patch lead (.page-home .coming::before/::after), the rails whose stops are their controls, and the four page tubes (Plans dial, Ideas map, To do bars, Status needle). This is the same machine, wired better.

HOME (home.html, _ask.html, _ui.html)
1. The glass.
   - The scrollback keeps Next up in inverse VT323, its date line and the small radar. Next up's name on the glass is no longer a link, and the '3 more after Next up' link goes. The patch lead already carries the eye to Coming up's row one, which is the link. So the first Tab stop on Home after the bar is the textarea, with no CSS reordering.
   - Replace the tracked 'VERA · FRI 2 OCT' with sentence-case VT323 at --tube, 'Vera, Friday 2 October', at 70% screen ink.
   - The title stays on the glass in Plex Sans Condensed 600 at about 2.5rem, bone (#ebe6da) with the E1 two-layer halo kept to the lit run. The lit run gets a hot core (color-mix(in srgb, var(--screen) 30%, #fff)) under the E1 halo, then the block .caret (E2), blinking 8 times then steady. The cursor appears only here.
   - The textarea stays as the tube's last rows, at least 3 rows. Its focus state is a 2px phosphor inset edge plus the --bloom halo (E4), as Send and the select already have.
2. The deck.
   - Change 'FROM' to sentence-case 'From' in Plex Sans 500 at --fs-small, in --label.
   - Turn 'Send where I am' into a 44px square icon toggle (crosshair icon) on the From row, between the select and the mic. The visible word 'Where I am' sits under the icon at 0.75rem. Its checked state is a sage (#86d9a6) inset edge and a lit 6px LED. On the phone, From, the toggle, the mic and Send all fit one row at 328px (the select shrinks to min-content).
   - The three ways to start lose their slab. Make them one ruled list on the case body: each is a 48px row with a 1px --rule top, its words in bone and 'usually Plans' in --dim on the same line, right-aligned. Hang them from a short steel stub rail with ring stops, the case's own rail. The slab fill goes, so the case's lower half reads lighter.
3. The case foot (.terminal-foot) becomes two lines.
   - The Ready line keeps its breathing lamp: 'Ready · OpenAI · gpt-6-luna · $2.00 a day', with Status →.
   - Under it, the kids' wishes as one line: a gift icon, then 'Maya 0 · Theo 0 open', the names as links, then 'All wishes →'. The wishes band under the case is deleted, which closes the lower-left hole. The case ends at the same height as the right column's To do band (about 840px at 1280×900).
4. Coming up (the desk's right track).
   - Rows take the day numeral law (graft A below).
   - The NOW lamp stays white-hot where the lead lands. The lead gets the warm-up: when the tube's bright line finishes (the existing warm-up keyframe), the lead lights from the socket to the lamp over 0.6s. It holds lit, then settles to steady over --afterglow. Under prefers-reduced-motion it is static and lit.
   - Keep 'Google Calendar is not connected…' as the band's foot, in --dim.
5. Finish setting up stays the one-line strip with three ring stops, which are setup's own rail. Its 2px left bar becomes wheat (#d8c38a), not amber, because amber is late only.
6. To do (.home-todo): square ticks (graft B below).
7. Lately added spans BOTH tracks under the bench (grid-column: 1 / -1), with its rows in two columns (1-3, then 4-5), each column hanging from a steel rail.
   - Each kind ring carries its grounded kind colour (graft C).
   - The newest idea's stop (#1) is the band's one lit lamp: a 10px phosphor dot with --lamp and the label 'newest' in VT323 at 0.875rem in --screen. No other stop glows.
   - Drop the '#1-#4' figures and keep 'Activity', 'Restaurant' and the like in the kind's grounded ink at 0.875rem.
   - The band head keeps '12 ideas', '+ Add an idea' and 'All ideas →'.
8. Section heads: each band head is Plex Sans Condensed 600 at --fs-head in --heading. A 2px cap in wheat (#d8c38a) runs over each band's top edge, in place of the grey --rule cap. The count follows the title in Plex Sans at --fs-small, with its figure in 600 tabular. Amber never appears in a head except '3 late', which is a link.

THE BAR (base.html)
- Add a Home key first, with the house icon and the word 'Home'.
- Replace the steel-blue latched slab (--rev #6b8396 fill) on the current page with a graphite key: background --key-hi, a 1px --key-edge, ink in --heading, a 2px phosphor underline 0.25rem below the word (12px wide, centred, with --rail-glow), and a 4px lit dot under it.
- The same treatment replaces --rev on EVERY latched key: Ideas' Any/Kind/For keys, To do's Open/Done/Cancelled/All, and Plans' List/Month. Each gets a graphite face, its existing LED made a lit 6px phosphor dot, and a 2px phosphor underline. --rev and --rev-cap leave the token sheet.
- On the phone the tab bar's current item gets the same dot and underline, not a steel fill.

TO DO (tasks.html)
- Square ticks (graft B).
- The due margin (.tick-line .hang) is set in Plex Sans at 0.8125rem: the date in 500 bone, with tabular figures only on digits, and 'was due 5 days ago' in amber 500 on the line under.
- The rail's stop beside each row is a 7px lamp: amber for late and pewter (#7a8590) for upcoming, with a dashed pewter ring for no date. The NOW stop is the lit phosphor lamp with its lit run to the right edge, which stays.
- 'Edit or snooze' stays in words.
- The terminal's late bars keep '#' bars in amber on the phosphor. The 'Late 3' row on the glass is a link to the late filter.

PLANS (plans.html, plans_month.html)
- The countdown dial keeps its lit day ticks with day numerals, now in the numeral face (graft A) at 1rem or more on the glass.
- The sweep wedge stops 4° short of any lit tick so it never crosses one in a still.
- The month grid's day numbers take the same numeral law. A day with a plan shows its numeral lit in --screen with a 1px phosphor underbar and a tight E1 halo, the same mark as on the dial. Days without plans are bone at 60%, and today keeps its filled cell.
- Plan chips in cells lose the cyan left bar and take their kind's grounded 2px left edge (graft C).
- The head row keeps 'Add a plan' as the green primary.

IDEAS (ideas.html)
- The map's downtown cluster (6, 8, 10): where blips sit within 18px, they share one stacked label ('6 · 8 · 10') with a 1px leader out to clear ground. Use one 44px target that links to #idea-6, and give the other two their own links in the label text.
- Ring labels are at 18px or more.
- Kind keys show their icon in the grounded kind colour (graft C).
- The Status select becomes a latched-key row (Open · Booked · Done · Dropped), so every filter on the page is one mechanism.

STATUS: keep the needle with its limit tick and ghost peak. The four-signal legend stays, and 'off' rings stay pewter.

SETTINGS and THE FORM: the folded Ready lip moves into the head row as a compact status chip (lamp + 'Ready') right of the title. The terminal column there is just the settings Contents, with no second header.

CHAT: unchanged except the bar, the deck changes and the graphite keys. Vera appears once in the terminal (her screen) and not beside every line.

PHONE (home-phone): the order is the glass, the deck, Coming up with its rail, To do, Lately added and the wishes line. Coming up's first row should sit within the first 1.5 screens. The phone glass drops the radar to 64px beside Next up to save about 60px.

TOKENS
- Add: --wheat #d8c38a (band caps and setup), --clay #c98a6a, --moss #8fae7a, --heather #a596b8, --dusk #7fa3b8 and --straw #cdbb7e (kinds).
- Remove --rev and --rev-cap.
- Amber is reserved for late and 'needs a look'.
- Green share target: at or under 60% of saturated pixels on Home.
briefs.borrows:
OWN JUDGES' FIXES, most-cited first:
(1) Square tick box back as the control, with the ring kept only as a stop lamp beside it. Asked by usability, skeptic and interaction; type is also helped by the lighter dates.
(2) Close the lower-left hole by moving the kids' wishes into the case's foot as one line and letting Lately added span both tracks. Asked by system, skeptic, style and interaction.
(3) Give Home's lower half one lamp: a lit 'newest' stop on Lately added. Asked by soul, with feedback asking for rails on Lately added.
(4) Grounded companion colour on section heads and kind rings: wheat caps, clay, moss and heather. Asked by feedback and style, and by the crossing lessons ('colour is replaced, never removed').
(5) A graphite key with a phosphor LED and underline in place of the steel-blue slab. Asked by the skeptic.
(6) Tab reaches the textarea first. Asked by interaction; done by removing the glass's duplicate links rather than by CSS order.
(7) A 2px phosphor focus edge on the textarea. Asked by interaction.
(8) Merge the downtown blips into one stacked label. Asked by system and soul.
(9) Ready lip into the head row on Settings and the form. Asked by soul and system.
(10) On the phone, 'Send where I am' on the From row as an icon with a word. Asked by soul, system and usability.
(11) Home key in the bar, with a dot under the current page. Asked by usability; round 12 feedback asked for the dot.
(12) Sentence-case 'From' and the date line, and tabular day numerals. Asked by type.
(13) The month grid's plan days take the dial's tick numeral style. Asked by system.
(14) The lead gets a faint afterglow when the tube warms. Asked by style.
(15) A thinner, less slabby case lower half. Asked by feedback.

GRAFTS FROM THE TOUR CAMP:

A) The waypoint day numeral, one face in row, ring and month cell. Source: x14a-waypoint-cross (Waypoint, Ruled). Files: cross/x14b-b/variants/x14a-waypoint-cross/sheet.css (the .num / .dial-num rules near L1467-1557, and the Coming up row) and its templates/home.html and plans_month.html. Shots: cross/x14b-b/out/x14a-waypoint-cross/shots/home.png and plans.png. Ledger T3-28 and X14a-20.
   - Rebuilt here as Plex Sans Condensed 300 at 2.25rem, tabular and lining, tracking -0.02em. Month and weekday are stacked beside it in Plex Mono 0.75rem at --dim. It leads each Coming up row.
   - The same numeral sits on the dial's lit ticks (on the glass, in --screen with E1 halo) and on the month grid's plan days (lit, with an underbar).
   - It replaces Patched's small 'Sun 4 Oct', which type faulted for untabular numerals.

B) The square tick, the corrected form of the tour's ring-as-tick. Source: x14a-sill-cross (Sill Line, Squared). Files: cross/x14b-b/variants/x14a-sill-cross/templates/_ui.html (L139-144, .tick-form / button.tick) and templates/home.html (L177, ol.line.checklist.tick-line), with the button.tick rules in its sheet.css. Shot: cross/x14b-b/out/x14a-sill-cross/shots/home.png and todo.png.
   - Rebuilt here as a 20px square with a 1.5px --edge border and 2px radius, inside a 44px hit area. It sits to the RIGHT of the rail's stop lamp, with the lamp on the rail and the box in the row.
   - Hover gives a sage edge with the E4 glow-in. When checked it is phosphor-filled with an on-bright check and fades over --afterglow.

C) Grounded kind colour in the ring only, with clay for restaurants. Source: ledger T1-30 (t1-track-revival and t1-switchboard-refine), seen in x14a-waypoint-cross's Lately added kind squares (shots/home.png).
   - Rebuilt here in the line's rings: restaurant clay #c98a6a, activity straw #cdbb7e, outing moss #8fae7a, trip and day trip dusk #7fa3b8, show heather #a596b8, seasonal clay-orange #c79a6a, event and other heather.
   - These replace .kind-restaurant { --kind: var(--amber) }, lemon, cyan, pink and lilac in sheet.css (L63, L70, L430/L2313, L528-530, L669-671), so amber means late alone.

D) The Home key with a lit dot under the current page. Source: x14a-trued-cross (Trued, Headlamp). Files: cross/x14b-a/variants/x14a-trued-cross/templates/base.html and the bar rules in its sheet.css. Shot: cross/x14b-a/out/x14a-trued-cross/shots/home.png.
   - Rebuilt here on the graphite key with a phosphor underline. The latched-key LED language stays the line's own.

LEDGER ADDITION: T1-35, the newest stop lit (t1-timetable-graft Night Departures). Rebuilt as Lately added's one lit 'newest' lamp, the section's single light.
briefs.avoids:
It answers each criticism directly:
- 'A ring you press is indistinguishable from a lamp' (usability, skeptic, interaction): the square box is the control and the ring is a lamp, one control, one look.
- 'Dead hole at lower left' and 'long dark tail under the kids' wishes' (system, style, skeptic, interaction): the wishes become one line in the case foot, and Lately added spans the width with content. The container is shrunk and nothing is stretched.
- 'Home's lower half has no light' (soul): one lamp per section, newest lit.
- 'The desk is close to colourless' and 'colour beyond green and amber is scarce' (style, feedback): wheat caps and grounded kind rings, with amber kept for late.
- 'Steel-blue latched key is a cold slab' (skeptic): graphite with a lit LED and underline.
- 'Tab reaches the tube's links before the box' (interaction): the duplicate links are removed.
- 'Faint textarea focus' (interaction): a 2px phosphor edge with bloom.
- 'Downtown blips overlap' (soul, system): one stacked label.
- 'Ready lip is a second header' (soul, system): it moves into the head row.
- 'No Home key' (usability): added.
- 'Send where I am wraps on phone' (soul, system, usability): it becomes an icon toggle on the From row.
- 'Tracked caps VERA · FRI 2 OCT and FROM' and 'untabular day numerals' (type): fixed.
- 'Plans month grid plain beside the dial' (system): one numeral mark for both.
- 'Case lower half is a slab' (feedback): the starters become a ruled list and the case shortens.
- The field's 'near-identical' complaint and title convergence (crossing lessons): the line keeps its case, glass title and patch lead, and takes an untried title.

What it GIVES UP to make room:
- the kids' wishes band;
- the '3 more after Next up' link and the linked name on the glass;
- Lately added's '#n' figures;
- the slab starter keys;
- the steel --rev fill;
- the amber and lemon kind colours;
- the Ideas Status select.
briefs.title: 'Anything for Vera to *plan*?', set on the glass as now: Plex Sans Condensed 600 in bone, with 'plan?' as the lit run (hot core plus E1 halo, the question mark inside the run) and the block cursor after it. It is NOT yet tried; the nearest are 'Anything to plan?' (t2-pocket-graft, 8.03, the tour's top title score) and 'Give Vera something to plan.' (on seven 14a crosses). It says FamilyDB's job in five words. 'Anything' takes in a weekend, a reminder, an idea and a wish, the virtue judges credited to 'something'. 'Vera' names who hears it, the virtue that lifted 'Give Vera…' over the bare 'Anything to plan?'. The question form is what a terminal prompt does: the glass asks, the cursor waits and the box answers, which suits the line whose idea is the question typed at the foot of its glass. The short lit word sits last, where the eye stops. It also moves Desk off the seven-way shared title, so the judges can compare it against 'Give Vera something to plan.' on Waypoint or Plate.
